sloka: राक्षसो ऽसीति हरयो हरिश्चासीति राक्षसाः ।अन्योन्यं समरे जघ्नुस्तस्मिंस्तमसि दारुणे ।। ६.४४.३ ।।।।
transliteration: rākṣaso 'sīti harayo hariścāsīti rākṣasāḥ ।anyonyaṁ samare jaghnustasmiṁstamasi dāruṇe ।। 6.44.3 ।।।।

translations.english: In the fierce darkness that prevailed, monkeys hit monkeys thinking to be Rakshasas and Rakshasas hit Rakshasas thinking to be Vanaras (not knowing in darkness) hit each other.
